$comment: Upstream sources this build is allowed to consume.
fetch.py refuses to download anything that is not described here, so a
typo or a tampered config cannot silently redirect the build at a
different host. Changing this file is a reviewable routing-policy change.
See SOURCES.md for why each source was selected.

ipv4_primary.description: Mainland China IPv4 CIDR set. This is the exact file Loyalsoldier/geoip adds as the 'cn' IPv4 category, so it is what geoip:cn resolves to.

ipv6_experimental.description: Mainland China IPv6 CIDR set. EXPERIMENTAL: never part of the default GL.iNet subscription.

domains_primary.description: Mainland China domain list in dnsmasq 'server=/domain/resolver' form. Loyalsoldier's china-list.txt is generated verbatim from this file; consuming it directly allows true commit-SHA pinning.

domains_secondary.description: Independent anomaly comparator only. Never unioned into published output; its content is not redistributed by this project.
